description: Na₄MgV₂O₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.52 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with six equivalent VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.55 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and two longer (2.18 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.27 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and two equivalent V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two equivalent V atoms.
